rows.owner_blocker: Explicit owner authorization for bunker-mvp bunker reap --apply is absent
rows.verification_command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 bunker-mvp 'hostname; /usr/local/bin/bunker --version; before=$(find /etc/apparmor.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -name \"home.*.bin.rootlesskit\" | wc -l); out=$(/usr/local/bin/bunker reap --dry-run); rc=$?; after=$(find /etc/apparmor.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -name \"home.*.bin.rootlesskit\" | wc -l); printf \"before_profiles=%s after_profiles=%s rc=%s\\n%s\\n\" \"$before\" \"$after\" \"$rc\" \"$out\"; test \"$before\" = \"$after\"; test \"$rc\" -eq 0'
